title: evidence_summary
description: Output contract of the tpa-evidence-analyzer (req. d2), soc-report-analyzer (req. e) and pentest-report-analyzer (req. f) agents. Rendered to DOCX by functions/delivery/renderers/evidence-summary/render.py. The delivery Function validates the agent's JSON against this file before the renderer starts (SCHEMA_DIRS); the output-verifier checks the content rules that a schema cannot express (every finding cited, no invented evidence).

title.description: Document title, e.g. 'SOC 2 Type II Reliance Summary'.

service.description: Empty or omitted for a supplier-wide evidence pack; the pipeline then stores under Reports/<Supplier>/_ALL-SERVICES/.

executiveSummary.description: Bullet per point: opinion/period/scope, exception or finding counts, currency of the evidence.

verdict.description: Reliance/acceptance statement, e.g. 'RELIANCE OK', 'RELIANCE WITH CONDITIONS', 'ACCEPTABLE', 'CONDITIONS', 'UNACCEPTABLE'.

identification.description: Identification table (report type, auditor/tester, period, scope, version, issue date).

inventory.description: d2 per-file evidence inventory; free column set (the renderer takes the first row's keys as the header). Every row carries a `source` column: `fresh` when the file was read in this run, `reused:<runId>` when its facts came from the evidence cache — a reader must be able to see which evidence was re-verified today and which was carried forward, and the approver signs off on that distinction (agents/tpa-evidence-analyzer_instructions.md, Evidence already extracted).

timeline.description: Validity timeline (issued / period covered / expiry / next evidence due).

source.description: File + page/section the finding is evidenced by — never blank (verifier rule: every finding traceable).

status.description: e.g. Open, Remediated, Retest pending, Accepted risk.

findings.description: Findings / exceptions register. An empty array is allowed ONLY when executiveSummary states that the evidence carried no adverse finding.

cuecs.description: SOC complementary user-entity controls and the Euronext-side owner/status.

owner.description: Role or placeholder UPN — never a real mailbox.

auditArtifacts.description: Audit artefacts of a chunked full-coverage analysis (chunk inventory, per-chunk extraction JSON, coverage statement, verdict). governance/DATA_PROTECTION_GUARDRAILS.md section 4 requires a pdf-full-coverage-analyzer deliverable to ship them with the report; the pipeline uploads each one to Reports/<Supplier>/<Service>/audit/<date>/ and the renderer lists them in an appendix so the report itself names its own evidence. sha256 is of the artefact bytes as uploaded.

cacheRecords.description: Delta re-analysis (requirement d2): one entry per file READ IN FULL in this run. The pipeline writes them to the TPA Evidence Cache list AFTER the verifier passes and the report is approved, so the next assessment reads only what changed. Files whose facts were reused need no entry. Never include a computed status here — VALID / EXPIRING / EXPIRED are recomputed at each report date, never cached.

eTag.description: The eTag listChildren returned for this file in THIS run.

facts.description: Facts a reader cannot recompute: document type, issuer, content identification, scope statement, emission date, validity window, findings.
